name: Anyscale Endpoints API
description: Anyscale Endpoints provides an OpenAI-compatible API for serving open-source LLMs. Supports chat completions and completions endpoints with models like Llama, Mistral, and CodeLlama. Note: Anyscale Endpoints has been merged into Fireworks AI.
